_note: What you see: Compensation cycle detail (CompReviewCycleDetail): a pay round (for example the collective pay rise of 1 juli plus individual pay) with budget used, a table of proposed adjustments per employee (current, proposed, band position), bulk apply to many employees, the step "Apply" that puts it into payroll, and a pay transparency tab or card (gender pay gap per grade, EU pay transparency).
_note_nl: Wat je ziet: Compensation cycle detail (CompReviewCycleDetail): a pay round (e.g. collectieve loonsverhoging 1 juli plus individuele beloning) with budget used, a table of proposed adjustments per employee (current, proposed, band position), bulk apply to many employees, the step "Doorvoeren" that effectuates into payroll, and a pay transparency tab or card (gender pay gap per grade, EU pay transparency).
